subject: Decision & ownership: ClearSky BYOK/KMS evidence request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Team —

ClearSky (HS-4721) raised a formal BYOK/KMS evidence request in their security questionnaire. They need:
- confirmation on our KMS rotation controls + key provenance (they want a PDF snapshot)
- a short MOP (minimal operational playbook) describing provisioning steps when they choose Private/VPC+BYOK
- audit-log retention policy and example log export (last 90 days)

This is time-sensitive: procurement wants these artifacts for their security board by Friday. I think we should:
1) Triage and accept (or scope carveout) the evidence request now,
2) Assign an owner for each artifact (soc2 snapshot, MOP, audit export), and
3) Decide whether we ship a templated evidence pack or perform a tailored extraction.

Proposed owners: Marissa (MOP + customer-facing narrative), Karthik (KMS key provenance + rotation statement), Neha (audit logs + retention confirmation).

Can you confirm you can own these and give ETA? Also flag any blockers (legal redlines, data locality, or infra ops work) so I can escalate.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: clear_sky_byoevidence_checklist_v1.pdf (checklist stub)
From: Claire Dunn <claire@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick note. A few clarifications from our side:
- For KMS provenance we only need the statement and timestamp ranges; we do not need customer key material.
- MOP should include a short checklist we can drop into our runbook and a line about expected downtime (if any) during onboarding.
- Audit logs: export in JSON or CSV is fine; sample with field descriptions would be perfect.

Procurement is pushing for a go/no-go on the vendor security board by Friday 26th. If you can give an ETA this week on deliverables that would help.

Claire Dunn
Sr. Security Program Manager
ClearSky Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Thanks for the ping — I can take the MOP and customer-facing narrative. Quick notes / risks from product:

- MOP scope: we will produce a 2-page MOP (onboarding steps + verification checklist) and a short paragraph about expected latency/maintenance impact. I will re-use our internal private-deploy template and keep it customer-friendly. ETA: Wed EOD (23rd).
- KMS / BYOK caveat: we should not provide operational logs that reveal internal hostnames or user PII. Karthik — if the audit export needs filtering we should include that in the ETA.
- Legal: if we include specific rotation windows or retention exceptions, legal may want to sign off on the language. I will loop Legal if we have to deviate from standard wording.

Action items for my part:
- Draft MOP + short FAQ for customer runbook (Marissa)
- Confirm whether we can provide a redacted audit sample (Neha)
- Draft KMS provenance statement with rotation schedule (Karthik)

I’ll attach the draft MOP and the evidence checklist as starting points.

Marissa
Product Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mop-byo-onboarding.xlsx (stub), clear_sky_byoevidence_checklist_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 14:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Confirming I’ll produce the KMS provenance + rotation statement. Quick technical clarifications:
- We can provide a signed statement of rotation policy (90-day rotation for ephemeral keys; CMKs rotate per customer policy). We will not share key material or KMS CMK IDs that could be used to infer infrastructure.
- For provenance we can include: creation timestamp ranges, KMS backend (cloud KMS name), and a sanitized timeline of key events. I’ll produce a one-page PDF. ETA: Thu 25th COB.

Neha — what is the earliest you can produce a 90-day sample with redaction rules? If you need infra to generate an export we should spin a run now.

Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Quick update — I ran a scope on the audit export this morning. Summary:
- We can produce a 90-day audit export in CSV with the requested fields (timestamp, event_type, resource_type, principal, outcome).
- We will need a redaction filter to remove hostnames and any request-level PII. I can apply that filter and produce a redacted sample by Fri 26th 10:00am PT.
- Caveat: if customer asks for raw logs (unredacted) Legal will require an NDA amendment and Security will require a timeboxed access window.

Next steps I’ll take: generate redacted CSV sample, drop into Confluence page, attach to HubSpot deal. If Legal needs to review the KMS wording we should cc legal@redwood.com — Marissa, do you want me to loop them or will you?

-Neha
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
On Tue, 22 Jun 2026 at 14:09, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Confirming I’ll produce the KMS provenance + rotation statement...

> [quoted for context]

To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Jonas / team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Procurement confirms the board meeting is now scheduled for Fri 26th at 2pm PT. If you can shoot the draft MOP + redacted audit sample and the KMS statement into the Confluence link (or send directly) by 10am PT Friday we can include them in the packet. If legal review is required please flag ASAP — procurement can accept "legal review pending" language on the packet but needs to see drafts.

Thanks — Claire
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 07:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Perfect — thanks all. Summary / owner checklist for exec escalation:
- Marissa: MOP + customer narrative — deliver Wed 23rd EOD (Marissa confirmed).
- Karthik: KMS provenance PDF — deliver Thu 25th COB.
- Neha: redacted 90-day audit CSV sample — deliver Fri 26th 10:00am PT.

I’ll own the exec packet and drop the artifacts into the Confluence page and HubSpot deal. If any blocker arises (legal signoff / infra time), ping me directly and I’ll escalate to Legal/Eng leadership.

Jonas
From: Claire Dunn <claire@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSky BYOK evidence request — who owns decision?

Received the MOP and KMS statement — thanks, team. We have a follow-up question on retention carveouts; will loop back after the board meeting.
